command.textOpacity: Wallpaper Sync: Adjust Code Text Opacity
setting.mode: Background source: Wallpaper Engine or folder slideshow
setting.folderPath: Absolute slideshow folder path. Only files directly inside this folder are included.
setting.slideshowSeconds: Seconds per file. Videos switch at the interval without waiting for playback to finish.
setting.executable: Full path to wallpaper64.exe or wallpaper32.exe
setting.monitor: Use -1 for the default wallpaper query, or a monitor index starting at 0
setting.pollSeconds: Seconds to wait after each Wallpaper Engine query
setting.opacity: Background opacity: 0 is transparent, 1 is fully visible
setting.textOpacity: Code text opacity: 0 is transparent, 1 is fully visible; applies while the background is enabled
setting.language: Interface language. Auto follows VS Code; an explicit selection overrides it. Native command titles still follow VS Code.
language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language
